record.summary: Require complete closed-window harmonic liquidity and current active liquidity before admitting swaps.

definition.help: Warmup begins at the next sample boundary. Any positive zero-liquidity duration refuses qualification; conservative window-local rounding cannot give flash-added liquidity instant history. Every successful liquidity change is observed, and LP exits remain open. Not token value or guaranteed market depth.
